scriptOverride.reason: Action grants a custom-duration lasting effect (Durations.Custom in ringteki) whose expiry is driven by three separate event listeners (the top conflict-deck card moving, the conflict phase ending, or the deck being shuffled) tracking one specific card instance captured at activation time. card-schema.json's lastingEffect duration values are the fixed untilEndOfConflict/Phase/Round set - there's no generic way to express an ad hoc multi-event 'until' clause tied to a runtime-captured reference.
